title: Asset Production Governance, Locking, Dependency & Review Layer
objective: Build an ARI-aware production overlay over existing VCS/storage: source-vs-generated distinction, large/binary asset status, advisory/exclusive locks where backend supports them, derivative/dependency impact, stale-build detection, review/approval state, task/owner linkage, batch provenance and cache/build visibility.

scope.purpose: Provide ARI-aware asset-production governance over existing VCS/storage without replacing the underlying version-control or storage authority.
scope.completion_gate: Representative production assets can expose inspectable governance, lock/dependency/review/provenance and stale-build evidence over existing VCS/storage while ARI identity/provenance rules remain authoritative and no replacement VCS is created.

selection_boundaries: PCA-01 retained production-recipe and prepared derivative-registration authority; PCA-15 consumed explicit recipe references without minting recipes or executing providers.
ARI-02 retained resource identity authority and ARI-03 retained derivative-lineage authority; PCA-15 projected explicit references and created no parallel canonical asset ledger.
Existing VCS and storage remained authoritative backends; PCA-15 created no replacement VCS, object store or storage authority.
Owner domains retained canonical asset/content mutation authority; PCA-15 performed no owner asset mutation, lock mutation, automatic source edit, network/provider execution or publication.

Advisory/exclusive lock planning remained backend-aware and unsupported exclusivity failed closed. Dependency impact, stale-build diagnostics, review/task ownership, provenance and cache/build visibility remained deterministic evidence only.

ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 was reconsulted after exact-tree PCA-15 publication. FOUR_LANE_RELEASE_BARRIER and MCS start gates are now satisfied; PCA-16 is an MCS golden-proof dependency rather than an ordinary start gate.

The owner-approved PCA planning surface names MCS-01 as the cross-program successor. MCS-01 is selected_not_started only; PCA-16, MCCS, MRCS, MSAS, MNCS, SMB-08 and downstream work remain unauthorized until separately selected/governed-started.

red.failure_signature: All four focused acceptance cases failed expected-null-not-to-be-null because the authorized PCA-15 production module was intentionally absent.

green_diagnostic.failure_signature: tools/verify_pca_15.py was intentionally absent before proof surfaces were added.

proof_repair.failure_signature: Verifier expected lowercase source-vs-generated while the canonical profile boundary begins Source-vs-generated; product behavior remained green.

next_action: PCA-15 is closed. MCS-01 is selected_not_started after fresh ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH reconciliation and requires a later owner Continue before governed start.

stop_reason.evidence: PCA-15 exact-head validation passed on Linux and Windows with deterministic comparison; PR 539 published the exact validated tree; the application lease was released; fresh DAG reconciliation makes MCS ordinary start eligible and the owner-approved PCA successor selects MCS-01 inertly; AIOC closeout is the remaining publication step represented by this candidate.
